metadata.title: Amana – Trusted Parcel Delivery by Travelers
metadata.description: Send your parcels with travelers going your way. Fast, affordable, and trusted.
metadata.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer parcel delivery by trusted travelers.

hero.description: Find someone who is already travelling to your destination and send your parcel for less. The payment stays protected until delivery.

search.noTripsSubtitle: Try a different destination or clear the date filter.

routes.heading: Popular routes
routes.subheading: Real prices from the trips published right now.

travelerBand.heading: Travelling soon? Publish your trip and earn money
travelerBand.description: Turn the free space in your luggage into extra income. You set the price per kilo, choose the parcels you accept and get paid once the parcel is delivered.
travelerBand.note: Free to publish. Amana keeps 10% only when a delivery is completed.

items.title: Fair prices
items.desc: Travellers set their own price per kilo, and you see it before booking. Often far cheaper than a courier for the same route.

items.title: Protected payment
items.desc: Your money is held by Amana and only released to the traveller when you give them your delivery code. If something goes wrong, our team steps in.

items.title: People you can trust
items.desc: Every member verifies their identity with an ID document and a selfie video, and members rate each other after every delivery.

howItWorks.heading: How Amana works
howItWorks.subheading: Send your parcel in 4 simple steps. No hassle, no hidden fees.

steps.title: Find a Traveler
steps.desc: Search for verified travelers heading to your destination on your preferred date.

steps.title: Book & Pay Securely
steps.desc: Submit your parcel details and pay securely. Funds are held in escrow until delivery.

steps.title: Hand Off Your Parcel
steps.desc: Meet the traveler at the pickup point and hand over your parcel.

steps.title: Track & Receive
steps.desc: Track your parcel in real time. Payment is released to the traveler on delivery.

footer.tagline: Trusted peer-to-peer parcel delivery connecting senders with travelers worldwide.
footer.madeWith: Made with ❤️ for travelers and senders everywhere.

disclaimerItems: No cash, banknotes, coins or financial instruments
High-value items are allowed — declare their real value; the traveler sees it before accepting
No prescription drugs, controlled substances or alcohol
No weapons, flammables or hazardous materials
No perishable food without traveler's explicit agreement
newParcel.disclaimerFooter: Amana is not liable for loss or damage of prohibited or undeclared high-value items. Declaring a false value may result in account suspension.

profile.consentLabel: I agree that Amana uses my ID and selfie video to verify my identity and for safety. The video is deleted 30 days after the review; the ID photos are kept while my account is open and up to 5 years after my last delivery, in case of a dispute or a legal claim (see the Privacy Policy).
profile.consentRequired: Please accept the consent to continue.

privacy.title: Privacy & your data
privacy.intro: Download a copy of everything Amana holds about you, or close your account. Read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for details.

privacy.deleteIntro: Your profile is removed right away and other members will see "Deleted user". If you have used Amana for deliveries, we keep your ID documents and your name and phone in a restricted archive for 5 years after your last delivery, only for disputes or legal claims, then delete them.
privacy.deleteUnderstand: I understand this cannot be undone.
